user.title: Connect to Plastic Slinger
user.description: Enter the address of your Plastic Slinger service and an API key created in the app under Settings > API keys.

data_description.url: The address you open the app at, e.g. http://plasticslinger.example.lan:6060
data_description.api_key: Starts with ps_. It is shown once, when the key is created.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only if the app uses a certificate Home Assistant doesn't trust (e.g. a self-signed one).

reauth_confirm.title: New API key needed
reauth_confirm.description: {url} rejected the API key (it may have been revoked). Create a new key in the app under Settings > API keys.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the service at that address.

abort.already_configured: This service is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant asks Plastic Slinger for active prints (2-300).

dismiss_print.name: Dismiss finished print
dismiss_print.description: Clears a held completed or failed print from the active prints glance view.

printer_id.name: Printer ID
printer_id.description: The Plastic Slinger printer ID, as id in the sensor's printers list.

pause_print.name: Pause print
pause_print.description: Pauses the active print on a printer.

resume_print.name: Resume print
resume_print.description: Resumes a paused print on a printer.

cancel_print.name: Cancel print
cancel_print.description: Cancels the active or paused print on a printer.

set_light.name: Set or toggle chamber light
set_light.description: Turns the printer's chamber light on or off, or toggles it if on is omitted.

on.name: On
on.description: True for on, false for off, or omit to toggle.

set_auto_unload.name: Set or cycle auto-unload after print
set_auto_unload.description: Sets or cycles the printer's auto-unload mode (off, once, always).

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: off, once, or always (omit to cycle to the next mode).

skip_parts.name: Skip print parts
skip_parts.description: Skips one or more parts (EXCLUDE_OBJECT) on a Klipper/Moonraker printer mid-print.

names.name: Part names
names.description: One or more part names reported by the printer for the running print.
